description: Fetch readable web content/docs/PDFs from public URLs. Auto-cleans ads, preserves code blocks/tables, defaults to markdown. Supports batch urls (1-3), focus keyword, cache control, and pagination via startIndex.

cache.description: Cache mode: 'default' uses disk Markdown cache; 'reload' forces re-fetching upstream

focus.description: Keyword or section name to target (e.g. 'Auth', 'Config'); returns targeted window (~5000 chars) instead of burning tokens on full document

format.description: Content format (default: 'markdown' when raw is false): 'markdown' preserves headings, lists, fenced code blocks (with language) and GFM tables — better for technical docs; use 'text' for plain text

raw.description: Return the raw response body (HTML/plain text) without extraction

startIndex.description: Character offset to start reading from (for paging through long content)

urls.description: Batch URLs (1~3 URLs run concurrently, splitting maxChars budget; ideal for comparing search results)

name: fetchWebContent
